changelog: The browser identity is now consistently `VoxyWatch Agentic NOC`; per-installation tab-title editing was removed.
General Settings shows the effective HTTP port used by the running portal, including a custom `PORT` value.
Host timezone, NTP and DNS moved to Diagnostics as live read-only troubleshooting data. VoxyWatch no longer stores or changes these operating-system settings.
changelog_es: configuración general basada en el sistema
El portal usa la identidad fija `VoxyWatch Agentic NOC`; se retiró el título editable por instalación.
General muestra el puerto HTTP efectivo del proceso, incluido cualquier valor configurado mediante `PORT`, sin usar un valor hardcodeado.
